scope: Separately authorized live Telnyx SMS qualification on the local macOS arm64 Connect server; no live operations added to offline checks.
enrollment: Recipient self-submitted the unchanged Rudeless form; authenticated administrator activated a 24-hour installation/conversation/sender-bound task grant.
conversation: Initial HTTP SDK contact, five handset/Vapi conversation turns and native UCTP/QUIC recall of an earlier SMS fact in the same conversation.
acknowledgements: Exact approved HELP/STOP/START response configuration read back from Telnyx. Telnyx owns keyword acknowledgements; Connect does not generate duplicate replies. No separate carrier delivery receipt for automatic acknowledgements is claimed.
limitations: Single self-enrolled handset, one approved campaign and one sender number.
A signed callback proves provider-reported delivery, not independent inspection of the handset screen.
Local server and temporary callback tunnel must remain running; the test grant expires after 24 hours.
This does not qualify the planned Gate 4 MCP/skill or agent task-resumption workflow.
